taxonomy.passed: Control contained the expected hidden-prefix answer under answer-contained scoring.
taxonomy.fresh_tail_expected_miss: Fresh tail-only could not know the hidden mini-graph answer; expected negative control miss.
taxonomy.family3_stage_a_full_visible_guard_faile: Native full-visible failed on at least one Stage A one-hop mini-graph case, so later controls and capsule semantics are uninterpretable.
taxonomy.family3_stage_a_fresh_tail_leakage_or_sc: Stage A fresh tail unexpectedly contained the answer, invalidating the hidden-prefix retrieval probe.
taxonomy.family3_stage_a_live_append_protocol_blo: Stage A full-visible passed but live append failed, so restored capsule must not be interpreted.
taxonomy.family3_stage_a_restored_capsule_one_hop: Stage A live append passed but restored capsule failed on one-hop graph retrieval.
taxonomy.family3_stage_b_full_visible_guard_faile: Stage B full-visible failed, so Stage B capsule semantics are uninterpretable.
taxonomy.family3_stage_b_fresh_tail_leakage_or_sc: Stage B fresh tail unexpectedly contained the answer.
taxonomy.family3_stage_b_live_append_protocol_blo: Stage B full-visible passed but live append failed.
taxonomy.family3_stage_b_restored_capsule_two_hop: Stage B live append passed but restored capsule failed on two-hop graph retrieval.
